comment: Vendor-name policy of the 1.7 rebrand (REBRAND F). Read by
scripts/myrmidon/vendor-name/check-vendor-name.mjs in CI and by the instance
settings panel (GET /api/myrmidon/vendor-name-check).
mode: ratchet — the visible count of the built bundle and of the recorded
response snapshots may not grow above the baseline below. After REBRAND A
(visible UI strings) and REBRAND B (server texts) have merged, set mode to
"strict" and lower the baselines in the same PR: strict allows only the
exceptions declared here. Mode precedence: --mode flag, then
MYRMIDON_VENDOR_NAME_CHECK_MODE, then this field.
baseline: the number of visible vendor-name occurrences (/\bPaperclip\b/)
recorded when this file was last refreshed. Never raise a baseline to make
CI pass — remove the occurrence or add a reasoned exception instead.
paths: whole files that may carry the vendor name — the licence and the
third-party notices, and source maps (a debug artifact, not the shipped
interface).
contentPatterns: spans blanked out before counting. The list mirrors the
allowlist of the source-side guard
ui/src/lib/myrmidon-branding-guard.myrmidon.test.ts (B1a), extended with the
attribution the export and licence panels show in every locale
("Base: Paperclip {{version}} (MIT)"): the vendor's real external services
(Paperclip Cloud / Labs / EE / Enterprise), the wire identifiers
X-Paperclip-* and the MIT attribution, plus the legacy "Paperclip …"
recovery-notice sentences that comments stored before the rename still
carry. A new vendor mention that is not one of these fails the gate —
extend this list only with a reason, never to silence a leak.
